# SIRE Eligibility
SIRE is an undergraduate first-time researcher program. The page describes eligibility for rising sophomores, third-year Oxford graduates, or transfer students in Emory College. Applicants must be in good standing, have little or no prior research experience, lack a current research mentor, and remain enrolled in ECAS. Research in any discipline, including STEM, is eligible.
# SIRE Timing
The SIRE page says applications open in spring.
# SIRE Compensation
Compensation may be through work-study when eligible or through course credit. Mentors document hours for students pursuing credit.
